> Advice for Firefighters
1 As in any fire, wear self-contained breathing apparatus (MSHA/NIOSH approved or equivalent)and full
protective gear.
2 Fight fire from a safe distance, with adequate cover.
3 Prevent fire extinguishing water from contaminating surface water or the ground water system.
Section6 Accidental Release Measure -
> Personal Precautions, Protective Equipment and Emergency Procedures
1 Ensure adequate ventilation. Remove all sources of ignition.
2 Evacuate personnel to safe areas. Keep people away from and upwind of spill/leak.
3 Use personal protective equipment. Avoid breathing vapours, mist, gas or dust.
> Environmental Precautions
1 Prevent further leakage or spillage if safe to do so.
2 Discharge into the environment must be avoided.
> Methods and Materials for Containment and Cleaning Up
1 Absorb spilled material in dry sand or inert absorbent. In case of large amount of spillage, contain a spill by
bunding.
2 Adhered or collected material should be promptly disposed of, in accordance with appropriate laws and
regulations.
3 Remove all sources of ignition. Use spark-proof tools and explosion-proof equipment.
Section? Handling and Storage
> Precautions for Handling
1 Handling is performed in a well ventilated place.
2 Wear suitable protective equipment.
3 Avoid contact with skin and eyes. *
4 Keep away from heat/sparks/open flames/ hot surfaces.
5 Take precautionary measures against static discharges.
> Precautions for Storage
1 Keep containers tightly closed.
2 Keep containers in a dry, cool and well-ventilated place.
3 Keep away from heat/sparks/open flames/ hot surfaces.
4 Store away from incompatible materials and foodstuff containers.

Product Description
Molybdenum dichloride dioxide (MoO,Cl,) is a versatile inorganic compound
with a wide range of applications, mainly concentrated in the fields of catalysis
and semiconductor materials.
In terms of catalysis, molybdenum dichloride dioxide serves as a catalyst or
catalyst precursor and is widely used in organic synthesis and petroleum
refining:
e Inorganic synthesis, it catalyzes the oxidation of alcohols to
aldehydes/ketones, the reduction of ketones to secondary alcohols, the
hydrogenation of alkenes and other reactions to improve selectivity; it
also promotes thioacetalization reactions as well as Biginelli/Hantzsch
reactions, which are applied to the synthesis of pharmaceutical
intermediates.
e In petroleum refining, it acts as a hydrogenation catalyst to accelerate
the removal of sulfides and nitrides, thus enhancing the cleanliness of 国
fuels.
In the field of semiconductor materials, molybdenum dichloride dioxide is a
key precursor for preparing molybdenum-based thin films. Through atomic
layer deposition (ALD) or plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition ,
(PECVD) technology, it can be converted into molybdenum oxide thin films,
which are applied to transistor gates, interconnection layers, sensors and
optical devices. Especially in advanced processes at 7nm and below, the
molybdenum films deposited by it feature low resistivity (e.g., 12.9 uQ-cm)
and high coverage, and can replace tungsten or copper to reduce fluorine
residues and equipment corrosion, thereby improving device reliability.
In addition, it is used in the-pyeparetion of high-dielectric materials and
memory devices in the eledrdnic inatefials field. However, attention should be
paid to its sensitivity to moisture, end it Ageds to be stored in a moisture-proof
environment. \ By eA j
